_comment: CI's floor for the evaluation replay (quality.yml): the committed replies replay deterministically, so these are today's numbers and any change to the shared post-processing that reads them worse fails. Raise them when a change reads better; lower one only with the reason in the pull request. Units match exactly after clinical normalisation since 2026-11-09 (a cut-off unit no longer counts), which read LDL's 'mg/dL (calc)' as wrong: 75 values, 61 LOINC, 2 extra numbers, 1 wrong value not flagged. The planted* numbers are the errors planted in the right readings (evaluation/.../PlantedErrors.kt): the set mustn't shrink, and no more may slip through, in total and of each kind (plantedByKind: planted at least, notFlagged = planted - flagged at most), so one kind reading worse can't hide behind another reading better.
